fact: The Tongue of Madness is a strange edible fungus that resembles a large human tongue.
source_quote: discovered a strange edible fungus resembling a large human tongue
subject: Tongue of Madness

fact: Sarith describes the fungus as “the tastiest thing in the world.”
source_quote: Sarith praised it as “the tastiest thing in the world”
subject: Sarith

fact: Shuushar claims that eating the fungus allows one to connect with the gods.
source_quote: Shuushar solemnly claimed that eating it allowed one to connect with the gods
subject: Shuushar

fact: The companions initially consider gathering the fungus without eating it.
source_quote: The companions initially consider gathering it without eating it
subject: initial plan

fact: Thorin volunteers to eat the fungus first due to his strong constitution and resistance to poison.
source_quote: Thorin, trusting his strong constitution and resistance to poison, volunteered as the guinea pig
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin resists the fungus's magical effect after sensing a strange sensation.
source_quote: He sensed something unusual but resisted the effect
subject: Thorin consumption

fact: Thorin swallows the fungus normally and finds it quite tasty.
source_quote: swallowed normally, and found the mushroom quite tasty
subject: Thorin reaction

fact: For the following hour, Daz compulsively says every thought that enters his head.
source_quote: For the following hour, he compulsively said every thought that entered his head
subject: Daz affliction

fact: The group begins laughing at Daz's involuntary speech.
subject: Party reaction to Daz

fact: Daz’s thoughts settle into a loop where he wonders why everyone is laughing at him.
source_quote: his thoughts settled into a bewildered loop: “why are all these people laughing at me?”
subject: Daz loop

fact: The effect is identified as a familiar, harmless practical joke among Underdark denizens.
source_quote: The effect is revealed to be a familiar, harmless practical joke among the denizens of the Underdark
subject: Effect nature

fact: The rest of the party eats the fungus after realizing the effect is harmless.
source_quote: Seeing that the effect was harmless, the rest of the party ate as well
subject: Group consumption

fact: The tunnels fill with involuntary chatter from the party for an hour.
source_quote: The tunnels filled with involuntary chatter
subject: Party chatter

fact: Zalthir attempts to use monk's discipline to control his thoughts but fails.
source_quote: while Zalthir attempted a monk's discipline
subject: Zalthir

fact: Daz retains some of the fungus in his sack.
source_quote: Daz retained some of the fungus for possible use in future potions or tricks

fact: The party encounters a sudden rockfall near the end of the day's travel.
